name: Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark Scheme - Scheme I)
eligibility: Domestic and Foreign manufacturers with in-house testing facilities and quality control infrastructure.
process_steps: Step 1: Submission of online application on Manakonline portal with Form-V and prescribed application fee.
Step 2: Preliminary factory inspection by BIS auditor to verify manufacturing process, QC equipment, and testing competence.
Step 3: Drawing of independent test samples during inspection and testing in BIS recognized laboratory.
Step 4: Scrutiny of factory audit report and matching lab test results against the relevant Indian Standard.
Step 5: Grant of License (CML) and approval of marking fee upon submission of performance bank guarantee.
approx_timeline: Normal Option: 3 to 4 months | Simplified Option (for select domestic products): 30 days
fee_structure: Application Fee: ₹1,000 | Inspection Charges: ₹7,000/man-day + Lab testing fees at actuals + Annual Minimum Marking Fee
document_checklist: Process flow chart and manufacturing machinery list
List of in-house testing equipment with valid calibration certificates
Consent letter from CEO / Authorized signatory
Test certificate of raw materials and packaging materials

name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS - Scheme II)
eligibility: Manufacturers of IT goods, electronics, audio-video equipment, solar PV modules notified under MeitY and MNRE QCOs.
process_steps: Step 1: Register on the dedicated CRS portal (crsbis.in).
Step 2: Submit product sample to a BIS-recognized NABL accredited laboratory for testing as per relevant IS standard.
Step 3: Obtain valid test report issued within 90 days from the accredited laboratory.
Step 4: Submit online application on CRS portal attaching test reports, Brand Authorization letter, and undertaking.
Step 5: Grant of Registration Number (R-XXXXXXXX) and permission to affix Standard Mark (Self-declaration of conformity).
approx_timeline: 15 to 20 working days post test report submission
fee_structure: Application Fee: ₹53,000 (includes registration fee for 2 years) per standard per brand
document_checklist: Valid BIS Recognized Lab Test Report (less than 90 days old)
Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) document for foreign entities
Affidavit cum Undertaking for CRS compliance

name: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
eligibility: Overseas manufacturing units producing goods designated under mandatory Indian Quality Control Orders (QCOs) wanting to export to India.
process_steps: Step 1: Submission of Form-VI with requisite fee ($1000 USD) and nomination of an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR).
Step 2: Pre-audit document scrutiny by BIS Foreign Manufacturers Department (FMCD) in New Delhi.
Step 3: On-site overseas factory inspection by designated BIS technical officers.
Step 4: Drawing of samples for testing in India in designated BIS labs.
Step 5: Execution of Performance Bank Guarantee ($10,000 USD), payment of license fee, and grant of CML license.
approx_timeline: 4 to 6 months depending on visa clearances and sample transit
fee_structure: Application: $1,000 USD | Audit per-diem: Actuals + $350 USD/day | Marking fee: as per product schedule
document_checklist: Overseas factory layout & local government manufacturing license
AIR appointment agreement and Indian address proof

name: Hallmarking Scheme for Precious Metals (Gold & Silver)
eligibility: Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHC) and registered retail/wholesale jewellers across mandatory hallmarking districts in India.
process_steps: Step 1: Jewellers register online on Manakonline portal (zero fee for micro-enterprises with turnover < 40 lakh).
Step 2: Jeweller sends un-hallmarked jewellery lots to an automated BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC).
Step 3: AHC conducts sampling, X-ray fluorescence (XRF) screening, and Fire Assay (IS 1418).
Step 4: AHC generates unique 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) code via BIS server.
Step 5: Laser marking of 3 marks: (1) BIS Standard Logo, (2) Purity in Karat e.g. 22K916, (3) 6-digit HUID code.
approx_timeline: Jeweller Registration: Instant / 24 hours | Lot Hallmarking at AHC: 4 to 6 hours
fee_structure: Jeweller registration fee: ₹0 for turnover < ₹40 lakh, ₹2,500 to ₹8,000 for larger jewellers. Hallmarking fee: ₹45 per gold article.
